description.p: vv opens Parquet, Arrow/Feather, HDF5, Zarr and AnnData, NumPy .npz, R .rds / .RData, spreadsheets (xlsx/ods), SQLite, DuckDB, Cooler Hi-C, POD5, GenBank / EMBL, and the common genomic table formats in a fast windowed viewer with sort, filter, regex search, per-column statistics, a row-detail panel, and multi-tab navigation of multi-sheet / multi-dataset files.
